x: {event} is soon!
{event} is soon! Let's decorate everything!
{event} is soon, and {crowd} are coming! We promised the prettiest party {place_in}.
Balloons fly!
Oh! The balloons are floating into the sky!
Oh dear! The balloons tug off their strings and float into the sky like a flock of funny little clouds!
Catch the balloons!
{npc} shouts: "Catch the balloons with a ribbon!"
{npc} runs with a long ribbon: "Catch the balloons by their tails before they fly away for good!"
The balloons are high!
The balloons are high! We need magic words!
The balloons are already under the clouds, and our hands cannot reach. We need magic words!
What shall we do?
The balloons are back! What next?
The balloons are over our heads again! Shall we bake a cake or hang garlands?
Let's bake a cake!
Let's bake a cake! I am chief taster, no arguments!
Cake is my favourite job! Especially when it needs tasting, and tasting, and tasting again.
Garlands!
Let's hang garlands! Higher, higher!
Let's hang garlands high, so {crowd} can see them from the road!

end: Boom! What is that?
Suddenly something huge and round rolls toward us!
Suddenly something huge and round rolls right toward us with a loud "boom-boom"!

rec: We baked a cake.
Yesterday we baked a cake, and now something round is rolling!
Yesterday we baked a cake, and now something round and huge is rolling, and it is definitely not our cake.
We hung garlands.
Yesterday we hung garlands, and now something round is rolling!
Yesterday we hung garlands, and now something round, huge and suspiciously shiny rolls at us.

x: A ball rolls!
A huge ball rolls right at us!
Something huge and round rolls across {place_in}, and everyone jumps aside!
Stop, ball!
Hey, ball! Stop! This is a party!
Hey, roundy! This is a party, not a race! Please brake right now!
We need a cushion!
An idea! We need something soft!
I have an idea! We must put something big and soft in the way, and the ball will stop by itself!
The ball is too fast!
The ball is so fast! We need magic words!
The ball rolls too fast, and nothing soft is near. We need magic words!

q: Put something soft in the way

x: What about the ball?
The ball stands still! What shall we do?
The ball is finally still! Shall we cover it with pretty cloth or show it to everyone as it is?
The ball in a cloak!
Well, the ball in a cloak, like a real magician!
Well, the ball in a cloak, like a real magician! Now we just pull a rabbit out of it.
What a ball!
{npc} claps: "What a surprise for the party!"
{npc} claps: "What a surprise! No party ever had a ball like this!"

end: Where is {thing}?
The doors open, and {thing} is nowhere to be found!
The guests are at the door, and {thing} is nowhere to be found! What shall we do?

rec: The ball is under cloth.
Yesterday we covered the ball, and something flashed under it.
Yesterday we covered the ball with pretty cloth, and something flickered and flashed under it.
The ball is on show.
Yesterday we showed everyone the ball, and it flashed in the sun.
Yesterday we showed the ball to everyone, and it suddenly flashed as if it was hiding something.

x: Let's look together!
Calm down! The ball rolled everywhere, so look on it!
Calm down! The ball rolled all over {place_in}, so {thing} may be on it!
The ball shines!
Oh! Something shines and winks on the ball!
Look, look! Something shines and winks on the side of the ball, as if it wants to play hide-and-seek!
I will help!
{rival} blushes: "Let me help!"
{rival} blushes and asks: "May I help you? I am great at climbing ladders!"
The ball holds tight!
The ball is holding {thing_acc}! We need magic words!
The ball holds {thing_acc} so tightly that we cannot pull it off. We need magic words!

q: What does the shiny thing want to play?

x: Hooray! What next?
All is saved! How shall we celebrate now?
All is saved, and the ball even helped! How shall we start the party: with dancing or with a big feast?
Everyone dances!
We all dance! Even the ball sways a little.
We all dance together! Even the ball sways a little, and {rival} spins fastest of all.
Here is the cake!
Help yourselves! We have the biggest cake!
Help yourselves! Nobody ever had such a huge cake, and save me a slice too!

end: Hooray! A party!
The party was a hit: {name} and {fr} are heroes!
The party was a great success: {crowd} laugh and sing, and {name} and {fr} are the heroes!

x: Here is a note!
Look! Someone left a note {place_in}!
Look, here is a note! The letters look odd, as if the wind mixed them up.
YKS. Read from the end!
Aha, words backwards! From the end, YKS is SKY!
Aha, it is words backwards! If we read YKS from the end, we get SKY. Let's look at the sky!
Look at the sky!
We look up, and a second note hangs there!
We look up, and high above us a second note swings on a string.
The note is high!
The note is so high! We need magic words!
The note hangs so high that even tiptoes cannot reach it. We need magic words!

q: What do we get from the end?
How do we read the words in the note?
Where does the cipher YKS lead?

x: Where shall we go?
The second note has an arrow. Where shall we go?
The second note has an arrow and three pictures. Shall we follow the arrow or ask {npc}?
Follow the arrow!
Follow the arrow! It leads somewhere else.
Let's go where the arrow points! It seems to know the way better than we do.
{npc} knows!
{npc} whispers: "Pictures are a new cipher!"
{npc} smiles: "Pictures instead of letters is a cipher! Look for more notes: they were left for a reason."

end: Another note!
Another note flies in, and it has only pictures!
Suddenly another note flies in, and it has no letters at all, only four mysterious pictures!

rec: We followed the arrow.
Yesterday we followed the arrow and found a note with pictures.
Yesterday we followed the arrow, and it led us to a new note with pictures instead of letters.
We asked {npc}.
Yesterday we asked {npc} and learned about a picture cipher.
Yesterday we asked {npc} and learned the main thing: the note has pictures instead of letters, and they must be read in a special way.

x: Hat, egg, rabbit, egg.
Four pictures: a hat, an egg, a rabbit and an egg. What does it mean?
Instead of letters, four pictures: a hat, an egg, a rabbit and an egg. What are they trying to tell us?
Is it lunch?
Hat, egg, rabbit, egg... Is it a lunch menu?
Hat, egg, rabbit, egg... Is that the menu for the strangest lunch in the world?
H, E, R, E. HERE!
First letters: H, E, R, E. That spells HERE!
We need the first letters! H, E, R, E spells HERE. So the clue is somewhere close!
The lock is shut!
The little chest is locked! We need magic words!
The clue is in the little chest, but the lock will not open. We need magic words!

q: Which word from the first letters?
What pictures are in the note?

x: What shall we take?
The chest holds a key and a spyglass. What shall we take?
The chest holds an old key and a little spyglass. What shall we take with us?
We have the key!
We have the key! Now let's find what it opens.
We have the key! It is heavy, so it must open something really important.
I can see far!
Wow! You can see far, far away through the spyglass!
Wow, you can see everything through the spyglass! Even my nose looks huge and very important.

end: Numbers! What are they?
Suddenly strange numbers appear on the wall!
Suddenly strange numbers show on the wall: 3, 1, 6, 5. Below, a note: "Soon you will know who I am!"

rec: We have the key.
Yesterday we took the key, and it waits for its door.
Yesterday we took the key from the chest and now we look for the door it fits.
We have the spyglass.
Yesterday we took the spyglass and we look far, far away.
Yesterday we took the spyglass and now we can see even the farthest corners.

x: Numbers: 3, 1, 6, 5.
A number code! A is 1, B is 2, C is 3, and so on.
It is a number code! Each number is a letter in order: A is 1, B is 2, C is 3, D is 4, E is 5, F is 6.
Three is C, one is A, six is F, five is E. The word is CAFE!
Three is C, one is A, six is F, five is E. CAFE! I think my tummy decoded it first.
Surprise!
Surprise! All the notes are mine. And the treats are for you!
Surprise! All the notes are mine, and all these treats are for you, the best detectives {place_in}!
The door is shut!
The door with the treats is shut! We need magic words!
The treats are hidden behind a big door, and it is stuck. We need magic words!
What next?
The treats are waiting! What first?
The treats are waiting, and the detectives are tired. What first: eat or make up our own cipher?
Take everything!
Take as much as you like! It is all for you!
Take as much as you like! But first tell me: were the ciphers hard or just sneaky?
Our cipher!
Let's make up our own cipher! Only we will understand it.
Let's make up our own secret cipher that only friends understand. Can {rival} decode it?

end: All ciphers solved!
{name} solved every cipher, {rival} is a friend now!
{name} solved all the ciphers, the surprise worked, and {rival} is now a true friend of our team!

x: A storm is coming!
Look at those huge clouds! A storm is coming!
Huge clouds creep toward us! The storm will come before {event} starts.
It will be wet!
Hooray, a bath from the sky! But I have only one umbrella.
The sky bath is already filling! Pity I have only one umbrella, and a very small one.
Let's hide {thing_acc}!
We must hide {thing_acc} from the wind and rain!
We must hide {thing_acc} from the wind and rain, and then help everyone who cannot get home in time!
The wind is strong!
The wind is strong! We need magic words!
The wind is so strong that it tugs {thing_acc} from our hands. We need magic words!

q: What is small that the friend has?

x: Where do we start?
The rain is close! Where do we start?
The first drops are falling! Where do we start: hide {thing_acc} or call everyone to shelter?
Hide it fast!
Hide it fast! We cover everything with a big tarpaulin.
Hide it fast! We cover everything with a big tarpaulin and tie it with ropes, so the wind cannot carry it off.
Everyone here!
{npc} waves: "Everyone here, it is dry!"
{npc} waves and calls: "Come here quickly! It is dry and warm, and there is room for all!"

end: Wind! The canopy!
A gust of wind tears off the canopy, and it flies over us!
Suddenly a huge gust of wind tears off the canopy, and it flies right over our heads!

rec: All under the tarpaulin.
Yesterday we covered everything with a tarpaulin, but the wind won.
Yesterday we quickly covered everything with a tarpaulin and tied it with ropes, but the wind was stronger.
All in the shelter.
Yesterday we called everyone to shelter, but it is crowded.
Yesterday we called everyone to shelter, and it got crowded, but warm and fun.

x: Catch the canopy!
Run! We must catch the canopy before it flies away!
Run after the canopy! If we do not catch it, it may fly beyond the farthest hill.
I am in the canopy!
Oh! I am in the canopy, like a sweet in a wrapper!
Oh! I am a sweet in a big wrapper now! Just do not unwrap me too loudly.
Pull together!
All together! One, two, three, pull the canopy!
Together we are stronger than the wind! We take the edges and on "three" pull the canopy down.
The wind tears the canopy!
The wind tears the canopy! We need magic words!
The wind tears the canopy from our hands, and it is harder to hold. We need magic words!

q: What does the friend look like?

x: What next?
The canopy is caught! What do we do with it now?
The canopy is caught, but the wind grows stronger. Shall we make a roof or a wall of it?
The roof is ready!
Let's stretch the canopy like a roof: it is dry under it.
We stretch the canopy like a roof on four poles, and at once it is dry and cosy underneath.
A wall!
Let's stand the canopy like a wall, so the wind cannot blow.
Let's stand the canopy like a wall, so the wind blows past! I will be chief of walls and draughts.

end: {crowd} are there!
{crowd} are walking on the road right into the storm!
Suddenly {npc} points at the road: {crowd} are walking right into the storm, and they have no umbrellas!

rec: We have a roof.
Yesterday we made a roof of the canopy, and it is dry underneath.
Yesterday we made a roof of the canopy, and there was a dry place for everyone underneath.
The wall stops the wind.
Yesterday we stood the canopy like a wall, and the wind blows past.
Yesterday we stood the canopy like a wall, and the wind goes round us, like a polite guest.

x: Let's go and help!
We must help! Let's call everyone to our shelter!
Calm, no panic! We will call everyone to the shelter and lead them along the road, holding on to each other.
My umbrella!
Take my umbrella! It is small, but brave.
Take my umbrella! It is very small, but very brave, and it loves rain.
A chain!
Everyone in a chain! Hold hands and walk.
We make a chain and hold hands so nobody gets lost. We walk slowly and together!
The wind pushes!
The wind pushes us! We need magic words!
The wind pushes us sideways and will not let us go forward. We need magic words!
The storm is calming!
Everyone is safe! What now?
The storm calms, a rainbow shines over the roofs, and all are safe. What next: go {event_to} or have hot tea?
Let's go!
Let's go! For this I would even wade through puddles!
Let's go! For this we can wade through every puddle, even the deepest and coldest.
The tea is ready!
Hot tea with honey for all!
Hot tea with honey for all! Nothing warms you after a storm like a warm mug.

end: The storm is over!
The storm is over, all are safe, and {thing} is safe!
The storm is over, a rainbow shines, all are safe, and {name} and {fr} are the true heroes of the team!
